title: Sere — wound ecology, creatures, bosses
authority: Design text only. Does not rewrite native-bible catalogs, volume density weights, volume encounters, Canon lore, countries.json, or any prior slice file. Caps here are the Sere instance budget for this facet.

canon_pins.the_no: Every attempt to build outside the machine was bought, hollowed, or crushed.
canon_pins.law_text: The Mark is the only law that compounds. Live steel is allowed. Flower-law is the Court only.
canon_pins.humanoid_body: CX only for people. The enforcer is CX. The kiln, the harpy, the hound, the roach, and the rat are not people and are not CX bodies. The road watcher uses CX proportions under a full mask and is not a Concordia face.
canon_pins.flower_law: Hub only. Canon.HubLawRadius is 42 m and does not govern Sere. A beast kited back through that disk meets flowers, not a legal hunt. The Arena is the Hub exception.
canon_pins.gate: Sere is absent from Canon.Gates. Eight spokes only: Cyber, Ruins, Fantasy, Tunya, Frontier, Crime, Superhero, Crucible.

waystone.megaworld_map: HasLinkGate is false. AngleOf is Crime's gate angle 5π/4 plus 0.35 rad, which is 4.277 rad, still 0.435 rad short of the Permanent Dawn at 3π/2. Present radius is RingMeters × 1.35. RingMeters is 400 km × 0.55 m/km = 220 m, so the Sere present sits at 297 m: (−125.27, −269.29). That point is the continent on the megaworld plane. It is not an interior spawn.
waystone.gate_post: WorldGate.GatePost.Ensure sets waystone when the destination is Sere, tariffRate 0, inspectionLevel 0, ownerFaction empty. A spoke gate keeps the ring tariff, inspection 1, and an owner.
waystone.why_not_a_ninth_refusal: The three attempts inside the machine — Almsfolk, Lamplighters, Table-of-All — were bought, hollowed, or broken. The Ark Exodus left the ground from the First Launch Cradle because a Refusal could not be held here. Tunya is the other end of that umbilical. The Crucible is already the Eighth Refusal, and S17 keeps the sentence that there is no ninth. A waystone is a step with no law on it.

canon_pins.bleed: Weathering on the Verge–Keshar open: soot brick, oil concrete, a fossil stain in the pour. Kitbash of Coast and ash is material. It does not import a Ruins species and it does not open a portal.

pinewood_crossing.rule: The post stays Hub. The marked hound shares the veil hound skeleton and does not stand on that verge.

hollow–keshar is 10.80 m at (−39.98, 26.88), the slow ensnarement of a creditor. curtain–table is 11.07 m at (−22.93, 32.92), between the archive and the small ledger. Both stay empty of beasts. q_sere_open_table and q_sere_curtain_line already own the people there.
Soot brick, oil concrete, brand-tile course, furnace iron, one eye of fire in the hall. No Canon.cs transform. Volume spawn anchor is 'Furnace belt floor. Overlook is the worker scout.'

creatures.place_in_sere_life: It eats the grease the belt sheds. Oval body, six short thick legs, a pebble with feet. The count on the lip is biology. The Quiet Fall stays an unshipped verdict and does not acquire an omen by way of an insect.

density.where: The Keshar-facing 4 m lip of gap_verge_keshar. Day and night, because the bellows do not clock out. Inside the 4 m harpy circle, cap 0. Inside a placed furnace hall, cap 0. Zero on every other place in this file.

creatures.place_in_sere_life: Floor movement on the narrow seam where minted discs and proprietary seed miss each other. Grease, a torn ear, dark eyes. The yellow on the Crime row is a lamp. This seam has oil light, and the fur stays dull.

density.crime_owner: S09 arch_sodium_rat keeps night 6 and day 2 on the unclaimed street, and sere_added_by_this_slice 0. Those numbers stay. This cap is Sere's own seam.

creatures.law: Critters are not a boss budget. No window, no loot, no omen.
creatures.missing_mesh: Spawn nothing. Glowing eyes are the failure.

creatures.place_in_sere_life: One hound between the clearing bank and the mint. Shared skeleton with the veil hound. Smog in the coat. The brand is a single broken tile on the shoulder, a debt you can see, a scar. It heels. It bays when a second tile is offered. It is not a pack and not a mount.
creatures.player_aggro: during enc_one_tile, and only if struck or if a second brand is offered inside the 4 m circle

density.where: gap_aldermere_tally, one animal at the midpoint. The window uses that same animal. Peak is 1.
density.shared_skeleton: faun_veil_hound. Tunya's hounds stay on Tunya. Pinewood stays empty of this id.

creatures.missing_mesh: Spawn nothing. A wolf rename and a Quaternius dog are both the wrong body.

creatures.law: Three tiles are the donor. A fourth bolt fails the hook. Pocketing the fallen brand_tile fails q_s19_heat_not_a_name. Heat must not land on the_open_table or on keshar. No remembrance is minted for a cancelled stamp.
creatures.missing_mesh: Spawn nothing. A parrot, a pinup, and a CX face are all forbidden. Thin legs are forbidden.

creatures.place_in_sere_life: The one watcher for this spoke, planted in the brother-gap. Feet set, weapon low, mask with no mouth. The coat is street soot. The weapon is the clearing fork, wpn_pole_sere_fork, two short tines. It warns with the world's own line, then holds. It does not collect a tariff, does not inspect, and does not name an owner.
creatures.player_aggro: false outside the window. During enc_empty_post, true only after board, scout, and sound, and only inside the 4 m post. Walking past is free. Killing the watcher fails the clear.

density.where: gap_dovrane_keshar midpoint, all hours, the same body the window uses. Peak is 1. Zero inside either capital. Zero on the Frontier wagon mile.
density.other_skins: frontier_iron stays S13. crucible_shard stays unfielded per S17. This slice fields sere_invoice only.

mini_bosses.name: The Chest Stamp
mini_bosses.where: gap_verge_keshar, 4 m circle at (−31.76, 21.34), while furnace_belt is unplaced. The lip stays outside the circle.

schedule.label: Belt late morning, every second day

mini_bosses.player_aggro: true only after board, scout, and sound, and only inside the circle

telegraph.board: Worker board draws a harpy chest as a rectangle of three tiles.
telegraph.scout: From the lip the wings read harpy. The tiles are the only Sere mass.
telegraph.sound: Two-note scream. The second note is the stamp.

phases.name: Notes
phases.tell: The first note is the dive windup. The second is the stamp.
phases.player_response: Knock chest_tile on the second note. One tile leaves the chest. The heat application cancels.

phases.name: Bare dive
phases.tell: The grab remains. The faction hook does not.
phases.player_response: Meet the dive. Leave the tile on the ground. Do not bolt a fourth.

mini_bosses.does_not_arm_when: furnace_belt has a transform, or enc_compound_mark is inside its hour. Hours do not overlap the furnace evening. The placed-hall rule is the stack rule.

mini_bosses.name: One Tile
mini_bosses.where: gap_aldermere_tally, 4 m circle at (18.99, 5.14). Day only. The same hound as the ambient cap.
mini_bosses.player_aggro: The hound bays when a second brand is offered, and nips if struck. Standing in the circle without a tile is a heel, not a fight.

telegraph.board: A clerk slate draws one broken tile on a hound shoulder, and an empty second outline.
telegraph.scout: From either rim the chevron reads hound. One scar. No pack.
telegraph.sound: A bay that starts when the second outline is touched and stops when the hand leaves.

phases.name: Heel
phases.tell: The hound stands. The scar is one tile.
phases.player_response: Look. skill_presence_name_holder may name a holder who already exists. It may not mint a brand.

phases.name: Second outline
phases.tell: A hand with a tile starts the bay.
phases.player_response: Put the tile down outside the circle. Striking the hound fails the window.

mini_bosses.player_aggro: true only after board, scout, and sound, and only inside the post, and only during the window. The body is the ambient watcher. Clearing is leaving.

telegraph.scout: Mask, no mouth, fork low. At 100 m the shape is a planted person with a two-tine gap.
telegraph.sound: The refusal line, once, then steel set on stone. No second sentence.

phases.name: Blank lines
phases.tell: Three blanks. The watcher does not fill them.

phases.name: Hold

phases.player_response: Step out of the circle. The win is an empty post. A kill drops nothing.

boss.name: The Compound Mark
boss.where: furnace_belt hall, once that set is placed on the Verge-side seat of gap_verge_keshar. Overlook is scout-only and has no separate coordinate in Canon.
boss.until_placed: Spawn nothing. q_sere_furnace_scout remains the volume scout and is not repeated here.

schedule.label: Furnace evening, every third day
schedule.slice_rule: Clock unchanged. S17's enc_numeral_open keeps hours 17–19 on the Crucible face of this cron and still spawns no kiln.

telegraph_cite.board: Worker board at the furnace belt: eye and tile skirt.
telegraph_cite.scout: Furnace eye is the only emissive. Skirt is tiles, not cloth.
telegraph_cite.sound: Bellows, then a tile click that compounds.

phases_cite: Eye. Name the holder with skill_presence_name_holder. Anonymous damage feeds the mark.
Skirt. Crack one tile. Do not add your own brand.
Compound. Keep Esha's ledger out of the circle. Winning by selling the seed library fails.
boss.skill_note: The monster row writes skill_presence_name_the_holder. The skill file's id is skill_presence_name_holder. Bind the real id. Do not author a twin.
boss.body: Kiln torso, brand-tile skirt, chimney head, one fire eye. Scale 2.5× player height. Topology humanoid is the gait tag. The mesh is native. Fire stays in the eye and the furnace mouth.

weak_points.hint: remove tiles to cut the interest aura

boss.boss_rule_cite: Witness heat on Sere factions rises if you loot the body in front of a Tessera. Naming a real faction id redirects the next slam.
boss.remembrance_rule: Drops only when the eye cools on the vent, the ledger stayed outside the circle, and the seed library was not sold. Carrying the eye into the Crucible bay fails S17's numeral clear. A loot taken in front of a Tessera still raises witness heat and does not add a second token.
boss.stack: While this window is up, hyb_markharpy cap on the open is 0. Roaches stay on the Keshar lip, outside the hall. The hound and the watcher are on other opens.
boss.missing_mesh: Spawn nothing. A CX body, a full-body fire aura, and a Quaternius brute are all the wrong kiln.

tokens.rule: The one Sere remembrance. Vendor note: eye cooled, does not name Esha's ledger. This slice adds the placement and the bay ban. No second Sere remembrance is minted.

side_quests.title: Lip — Grease Is a Count
side_quests.giver_note: One of the density budget of 4, stood on the lip. Not Esha. Not a clone of a unique.

objectives.text: Stand on the Keshar-facing lip of the Verge open.
Count the roaches actually on the lip. The cap is 8. A larger number is a story.
See the leak they are eating. Leave them on it.
Give the count as bodies. A prophecy, or a dead roach, fails the errand.

side_quests.title: Open — A Balance With No Pans
side_quests.giver_note: A second enforcer, still inside budget 4. The other two remain on desks and the belt with no new pin.

objectives.text: Walk the open between Aldermere and the Tally House.
See the one tile. The crest on the bank is a balance with no pans.
Refuse the second tile. Offering it fails the errand.

side_quests.title: Stamp — Heat Misses the Ledger
side_quests.giver_note: Same lip enforcer as q_s19_lip_not_omen, a second loop, still one body.

objectives.text: Be on the open while the stamp window is up, and while the hall is still unplaced.
Knock one chest tile off on the stamp note so the heat does not name the Open Table or Keshar.
Leave the tile. Report a cancelled stamp. A pocketed brand_tile fails.

side_quests.waits_while: furnace_belt has no need to exist for this quest. The window does. If the hall is placed first, the window never arms and the quest cannot be finished. That is the honest stop.

side_quests.title: Post — Three Blank Lines
side_quests.offer: The post board on gap_dovrane_keshar during enc_empty_post. No NPC giver. Wend's two volume errands stay his.

objectives.text: Reach the brother-gap in the pre-dawn window.
Read tariff, inspection, and owner. All three are blank. The skin is sere_invoice.
Leave the lines blank. A faction name or a ninth spoke fails.
Step out. The clear is the empty post.

side_quests.why_no_delta: A faction delta would assign the owner the post is there to lack.
